name: Wilton Resources Corporation Limited
summary: Wilton Resources Corporation Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the exploration, mining, and production of gold ores in Indonesia. It holds interest in the Ciemas gold project covering a total area of 3,078.5 hectares located in West Java Province of Indonesia. The company is also involved in general trading, transportation, construction, real estate, logging, farming, plantation, forestry, electrical, mechanical, computer, workshop, and printing and services businesses. Wilton Resources Corporation Limited is based in Singapore.
